title: Detecting finite-module isomorphisms by the free rank-one module
statement: Let R be a finite commutative ring, D a category, and F,G:ModuleCat R→D functors preserving finite colimits. If a natural transformation alpha:F→G is invertible at the free rank-one module R, it is invertible at every finite R-module M.

source.place: isIso_app_of_rankOne, finite-presentation specialization for the Coefficients argument of blueprint sk-prop-a1-kummer.

proof.text: For a finite index set I, the free module on I is a finite coproduct of copies of R. Preservation of this coproduct and naturality of alpha extend invertibility from R to that free module. For a finite M, let P be the free R-module on the elements of M and g:P→M its canonical surjection. Since R and M are finite, P and ker(g) are finite. The map from the free module on ker(g) to P followed by g presents M as a cokernel. Both functors preserve this finite colimit and alpha is invertible at its two free terms. Colimit comparison therefore makes its component at M invertible.
